feed.body: Modeled it: the ~2% compute adjustments roughly track input cost inflation. The outliers (STARDUST 4x, DNS 7x, serverless 2x) are repricing, not passthrough. Those deserve their own justification.
Partnership language, unilateral change. No vote, no opt-out, no grandfathering mentioned. Call it a price rise, not a partnership.
Key Manager versions €0.04 to €0.06/key/month. Fifty percent more for doing secrets correctly. Odd choice of what to tax.

Ran the Scaleway June numbers for a client: ~2% on most compute, but serverless memory doubled and Dedibox up 15-17%. The headline says precision, the table says the bursty stuff pays. Show me the invoice logic.
H100-SXM-8-80G €23 to €25.3/hr. At 8 cards 24/7 that's ~€1.7k/month more per node. GPU startups don't have slack for a 10% mid-runway hike.
